user_intent_summary: Design a compact desktop lifting box that uses an external hand crank to rotate and raise/lower an internal platform by 80-100 mm while supporting 1 kg, with all mechanisms enclosed, safe, mechanically plausible, easy to assemble, and practical to manufacture.
product_intent: A compact desktop lifting device that enables manual lifting and lowering of a platform through external hand crank rotation, with the platform moving approximately 80-100 mm and supporting about 1 kg while maintaining mechanical stability and safety.

clauses.text: Design a compact desktop lifting box.
The user should rotate an external hand crank to raise and lower an internal platform.
The platform should lift approximately 80-100 mm and support a payload of approximately 1 kg.
The mechanism should be enclosed inside the housing.
The product should be safe to use, mechanically plausible, easy to assemble, and practical to manufacture.
Avoid obvious jamming or unstable operation.
Continuous or intermittent lifting is acceptable.
Multiple shafts, bearings, guides, and supports are allowed.

requirements.statement: The product must enable an internal platform to be raised and lowered through rotation of an external hand crank.

verification.observable: platform movement in response to hand crank rotation

requirements.statement: The internal platform must move approximately 80-100 mm during lifting and lowering operations.
The internal platform must support a payload of approximately 1 kg.
All mechanisms must be enclosed within the housing.
The product must be safe to use.
The product must be mechanically plausible, easy to assemble, and practical to manufacture.
The product must avoid obvious jamming or unstable operation.

verification.observable: smooth operation without jamming or instability
product dimensions relative to desktop space

requirements.statement: The product must operate manually only.

verification.observable: absence of power source or automated operation

freedoms.subject: type of lifting operation (continuous vs intermittent)
freedoms.statement: Continuous or intermittent lifting is acceptable.

freedoms.subject: mechanism components
freedoms.statement: Multiple shafts, bearings, guides, and supports are allowed.

relations.rationale: Platform movement is a consequence of hand crank rotation
Payload support is a consequence of hand crank rotation
Enclosure of mechanisms follows from the functional requirement

operating_scenarios.name: Normal operation with platform movement
operating_scenarios.description: User rotates hand crank to raise or lower the internal platform within the specified range while supporting the specified payload.

operating_scenarios.name: Enclosure maintenance and assembly
operating_scenarios.description: Assembly of internal mechanisms within the housing, with attention to mechanical plausibility and ease of manufacturing.

operating_scenarios.name: Safety and stability operation
operating_scenarios.description: Product operates without jamming or unstable behavior under normal usage conditions.

assumptions.statement: The specified 80-100 mm lifting range is sufficient for intended desktop use.
The specified 1 kg payload is achievable with manual hand crank operation.
The desktop-sized constraint allows for typical desk workspace dimensions.

unknowns.subject: specific mechanical transmission ratio
unknowns.reason: The request does not specify how the hand crank rotation translates to platform movement, nor what specific gear ratios are needed for the required lift and payload.
unknowns.resolvable_by: user to specify desired transmission ratio or mechanical advantage requirements

unknowns.subject: required torque for hand crank operation
unknowns.reason: While payload and lift range are specified, the required operational effort or torque needed to rotate the hand crank is not specified by the user.
unknowns.resolvable_by: user to specify acceptable operational effort or torque requirements

unknowns.subject: specific dimensions of the housing
unknowns.reason: While desktop-sized is specified, exact housing dimensions are not provided by the user.
unknowns.resolvable_by: user to specify exact housing dimensions for desktop placement

unknowns.subject: specific materials and manufacturing methods
unknowns.reason: Although manufacturing practicability is mentioned, specific material or manufacturing requirements are not provided.
unknowns.resolvable_by: user to specify materials or manufacturing constraints

discovery_outcomes.reason: All clauses from request and clarifications were identified and dispositioned
Both user intent summary and product intent were formulated correctly
All functional, performance, safety, and constraint requirements were derived from the clauses
Three freedoms were identified from the clarifications
Dependencies between requirements were correctly identified
Three realistic operating scenarios were derived from the request
Three assumptions were properly inferred from the request
Four unknowns were correctly identified as missing information that could not be determined from the request
